notes:
— Account intro: large mid-market CX platform serving retail + travel clients. Heavy seasonality (Nov–Jan holiday surge, major Black Friday spike).
— Business driver: keep live agent experience performant during incident bursts; avoid cascading queuing delays that blow SLAs. Want predictable unit cost during spikes.
— Workload profile: mix of agent-assist (real-time suggestions + tool-calls), ticket summarization for after-call wrap-up, and occasional reranking for search. Typical: 300 concurrent agent sessions during peak, 4–6 requests/sec per agent for multi-turn assist.
— Performance targets: <150ms median for agent-assist suggestions; p99 tail <500ms in steady-state. Under spikes need graceful degradation (fallback to distilled model or cached completions) rather than timeouts.
— Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for reserved capacity for predictability but need strong autoscale/burst controls. Interested in cost vs latency trade-offs and Optimize recommendations.
— Security/ops: must run in customer VPC for production (private plan considered), SAML SSO with SCIM, audit logging retention 1y, keys in customer KMS, and data residency for EU customers.
— POC ask: 2-week POC with synthetic spike tests (batch of incident bursts), validate autoscale policy, KV/prefix caching effectiveness, model-fallback latency, and canary rollout behavior. Provide test harness and sample workload.
— Quote from CTO: "We can tolerate lower fidelity outputs during peaks but cannot have agent UIs freeze — availability >99.9 for agent assist path."
— Technical concerns called out: network egress costs, VPC peering complexity, SAML SCIM mapping for 3,000 agents, and how Redwood handles long-tail KV cache memory under multi-tenant Dedicated pools.
— Actions taken: shared pricing deck (drive link), scheduled POC kickoff for 2024-11-11, SE to provide autoscale policy templates and example SLOs, security to send SOC2 artifact package.
— Open items: finalize SOW pricing bands, confirm SLAs for fallback model, get SOC2 evidence & internal legal redlines, test KMS integration in staging.
— Short-form next steps (from notes): "Run spike POC -> validate canary + fallback -> finalize term & SOW."
